Notes App

Write and organize notes with titles, instant search and last-edited timestamps. Everything is saved in your browser, and you can export all notes as a .txt file.

    No notes yet. Create one to get started.

    Notes save automatically as you type and stay in this browser only. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

    📖 How to use

    1. Click "New Note" and give it a title.
    2. Write the note body — your changes save automatically.
    3. Use the search box to filter your notes instantly.
    4. Select a note to edit it, or export everything as .txt.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    Where are my notes stored?

    Your notes live in your browser's localStorage on this device only. They are not uploaded anywhere, so clearing site data or switching devices will lose them unless you export first.

    Can I back up my notes?

    Yes — click "Export All (.txt)" at any time to download every note with its title and last-edited timestamp as a plain text file.

    Are my notes synced between devices?

    No, notes are private to this browser. They never leave your device — the export file is the only way to move them elsewhere.
